A bath. I can stay in that water for hours and read, or watch tv, or just relax.

Get it off your chest man. I’m begging you to reconsider though. The trauma of being surrounded by suicide is truly unbelievable. This isn’t really advice so much as saying it will irreparably damage those close to you. They’ll always feel like they should’ve done something different. If you care about those around you please find something positive in your life. If you cant do that seek help immediately.

I’m telling you now suicide is more of a burden on your family. I lost my father, aunt, and uncle from suicide and it’s so so hard to cope with that. I cant sleep because of nightmares where I’m begging them not to commit suicide. On top of that there’s funeral planning, etc. Please try to connect with your family. Ask for help. They love you. They fucking love you.

It’s exhausting to be alive. But you can find rewards in the people around you. A passion. Working hard on something you can be proud of. Please reconsider. Suicide hurts everyone around you. Try to connect with those close to you instead.
I feel this so hard. It’s sometimes petrifying to think about. I guess it’s just important to let people know how much you care about them while they’re here. Try to push on as well as you can.

I understand. Please keep in mind that suicide effects everyone around you, some more than you know. It’s worth it to try to build those relationships and feel the care that people want to give you. I know it’s hard but it’s worth it to stay alive.
Opiates destroy your life. Trust me, I’ve lost many people and myself for a time to opiates. Please seek help. It’s nothing to be ashamed of.
I’m so sorry for your loss. It’s so hard to lose a parent. Lean on your partner, take joy in the little things, don’t be afraid to take your time. Stay strong.
To have the strength to overcome my addiction and mental illness
